real_money_claim_policy: A trade is LIVE only when Jupiter execute returns Success plus a transaction signature.

truth_rules: Forward-only: first run establishes a boundary and never backfills real or simulated entries.
Only source-wallet-signed transactions that resolve to one quote-asset outflow and one token inflow are BUY events.
Airdrops, dust, plain transfers, LP operations and ambiguous multi-asset flows fail closed.
Copy size is floor(source input raw amount * 1%) for paper/shadow measurement only.
Primary paper exit is the first executable 3x quote or the first verified source-wallet sell, whichever occurs first.
4x is tracked as a shadow comparator and post-exit performance continues to be marked.
Real-money execution is prohibited for this experiment; no wallet signing or transaction submission is permitted.
GitHub Actions and any external runtime must remain paper/shadow-only.
